about: Archives and record sites that hold genealogical records, from genealogy-mcp and autoresearch-genealogy. Rebuilt with build_repositories.py; do not edit by hand. Entries were checked by those projects on the dates shown, not by this archive.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (records)
repositories.about: The largest free genealogy database: billions of indexed records and images from almost every country.
repositories.how: Search the index by name, but never stop there: much is not indexed. Open the image of every hit and cite the image, not the index.

repositories.name: FamilySearch Catalog (unindexed images)
repositories.about: Millions of filmed register books not covered by the name index: parish registers, confession lists, revision lists.
repositories.how: Search the catalogue by place (country → province → district → town), open the film for the right years and browse it frame by frame. Many films open only after signing in or in a FamilySearch centre.

repositories.name: Internet Archive — full-text search
repositories.about: Digitised books searchable by their recognised text: provincial memorial books, address calendars, lists of settlements, regimental histories, newspapers.
repositories.how: Choose 'Search text contents'. Old orthography is recognised poorly: search in the old spelling too (Сынковскій, Колодинъ) and by a short unusual fragment.

repositories.name: MyHeritage
repositories.about: Family trees and record collections with automatic Smart Matches and Record Matches.
repositories.how: Upload your tree (GEDCOM) and review the matches: most are namesakes. Treat other people's trees as leads, never as proof.

repositories.name: Geni
repositories.about: One shared world tree: a profile per person, merged between families.
repositories.how: Good for finding the other branches of your family. Check what sources a profile cites before trusting it.

repositories.name: WikiTree
repositories.about: A free collaborative world tree that requires sources for every profile.
repositories.how: Search by name and dates; profiles list their sources, so check them first.

repositories.name: Find a Grave
repositories.about: Hundreds of millions of grave memorials with photos of headstones, contributed by volunteers.
repositories.how: Search by name and cemetery or place; check the photograph of the stone, not just the transcription.

repositories.name: BillionGraves
repositories.about: GPS-tagged photographs of headstones with transcriptions.
repositories.how: Useful when Find a Grave has nothing; transcriptions are done by volunteers — read the photo yourself.

repositories.name: Arolsen Archives
repositories.about: The archive on victims of Nazi persecution: concentration camps, forced labourers taken to Germany, displaced persons after the war.
repositories.how: Try spellings as a German clerk heard them (Kubekow, Kubekoff, Melnikow) and search by date of birth.

repositories.name: Yad Vashem — Central Database of Shoah Victims' Names
repositories.about: Names of Jewish victims of the Holocaust from pages of testimony, lists and documents.
repositories.how: Pages of testimony often name parents and spouses and were filled in by relatives — contact details may lead to living family.

repositories.name: JewishGen
repositories.about: Databases, town pages and discussion groups for Jewish genealogy of Eastern Europe.
repositories.how: Start from the JewishGen Communities page of the town: it lists what records survive and where.

repositories.name: Matricula
repositories.about: Catholic parish registers of Austria, Germany, Poland, Slovenia, Serbia and other dioceses, as images.
repositories.how: Browse by diocese and parish; there is no name index, so know the parish first.

repositories.name: Geneanet
repositories.about: Family trees and indexed records, strongest for France and Western Europe.
repositories.how: Use as a source of leads; follow the cited records.

repositories.name: Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons
repositories.about: History of villages, districts, parishes, regiments; old photographs and maps in the public domain.
repositories.how: Read the village article in the local language Wikipedia: it often names the old parish and district. For images use https://commons.wikimedia.org and check the license on the individual file page.

repositories.name: Yandex Archive
repositories.about: Handwritten parish registers, confession lists and old newspapers recognised by Yandex; strongest for Moscow and the Moscow region.
repositories.how: It searches the handwriting itself, so it finds what no index has. Recognition errs: try spelling variants and check every hit on the image.

repositories.name: Guides to the fonds of Russian archives
repositories.about: Which archive and which fonds holds the books of a given church, volost or institution.
repositories.how: A fonds number is not a file number: inventories are often only in the reading room or on the archive's own site.

repositories.name: VGD forum (All-Russian Family Tree)
repositories.about: The largest Russian-language genealogy forum: threads per district and village, archive fonds numbers, news of digitisation.
repositories.how: Find the thread of your district: people post what survives and where. Treat posts as leads and check the documents.

repositories.name: Memory of the People (Pamyat Naroda)
repositories.about: Second World War records of the Soviet army from the Central Archive of the Ministry of Defence: registration cards, award sheets, casualty reports, hospital records, unit routes.
repositories.how: Search without the patronymic and with a birth year range; open the document scan — the index often misreads villages. The unit's route shows where the person fought.

repositories.name: OBD Memorial
repositories.about: The database of Soviet soldiers killed and missing in 1941–1945, prisoners of war and burials.
repositories.how: A person often has several records (report of loss, POW card, burial); compare all of them.

repositories.name: Heroes of the Great War 1914–1918
repositories.about: First World War records of the Russian army: casualty lists, hospitals, prisoners of war, awards.
repositories.how: Search is capricious: try without the patronymic, by year and by province; the home volost in the card is the best clue. The site uses the Russian Trusted Root CA (Ministry of Digital Development): give scripts that bundle, never disable TLS checks. Scans (/cdn/imagesfww/…) load with the same request the card page makes (with its cookies); HTTP 503 'technical works' means unavailable, not 'not found'. In casualty lists check the column header after the rank: it is often the company number, not the age.

repositories.name: Open List
repositories.about: An open wiki of victims of political repression in the USSR, compiled from regional books of memory.
repositories.how: Absence proves nothing: many regions are incomplete. A record gives the archive and the case number for a request.

repositories.name: Immortal Barrack
repositories.about: Victims of repression with biographies, photographs and documents added by relatives.
repositories.how: Check alongside Open List: the bases overlap but are not the same.

repositories.name: NashiPredki (Наши предки)
repositories.about: Volunteer indexes of parish registers, revision lists and confession lists, with pages for persons and villages that gather what has been indexed.
repositories.how: Search the village page as well as the name: it shows which books and years are indexed (and so which are not). An index line is a pointer — open the scan and cite archive, fond, opis, delo and folio.

repositories.name: Archive of metric books of Russia (metricabook.ru)
repositories.about: Scans of parish registers arranged by region, district and church, mostly from the second half of the 19th century to the 1910s.
repositories.how: There is no name index: find the church of the village first (the parish, not the village, is the unit), then read the years page by page. Note the archive citation printed with the scan.

repositories.name: Rodovid (Родовід)
repositories.about: A free Russian-language shared family tree with pages per person and per surname.
repositories.how: Use it to find other researchers of the same family and their leads; many profiles cite no document — treat them as hints, never as proof.

repositories.name: Road of Memory (Doroga Pamyati)
repositories.about: The Russian Ministry of Defence's memorial database of participants of the Second World War: photographs and cards with data from the war databases, filled in by relatives.
repositories.how: The cards repeat Pamyat Naroda and OBD Memorial data and add family photographs: a photo or a home village found here leads back to the original documents there.

repositories.name: Immortal Regiment (Bessmertny Polk)
repositories.about: Stories and photographs of Second World War soldiers and home-front workers posted by their families.
repositories.how: Written from family memory, not from documents: dates and units may be wrong. Check every fact in Pamyat Naroda and OBD Memorial; the author of a story may be a relative to contact.

repositories.name: Returned Names
repositories.about: Books of memory of victims of political repression collected by the National Library of Russia.
repositories.how: Search by surname across all regional books at once.

repositories.name: New Martyrs and Confessors (PSTGU)
repositories.about: Clergy and lay people who suffered for their faith in the Soviet period, with case details.
repositories.how: Essential for families of priests, deacons and psalm-readers.

repositories.name: Presidential Library
repositories.about: Digitised memorial books of provinces, directories, provincial gazettes.
repositories.how: Some items open only in reading rooms; search the catalogue by province and year.

repositories.name: National Electronic Library (NEB)
repositories.about: Scans of books, directories and dissertations from Russian libraries.
repositories.how: Full text is available for public-domain books; for others only the catalogue entry.

repositories.name: State Public Historical Library — e-library
repositories.about: Address calendars, memorial books, lists of settlements, pre-revolutionary reference books.
repositories.how: Lists of settlements give the volost and parish of a village — the key to finding its registers.

repositories.name: Etomesto — old maps
repositories.about: Old maps (Schubert, Mende, Red Army and other surveys) laid over a modern map.
repositories.how: Find vanished villages and see which church a village belonged to.

repositories.name: Churches of Russia (sobory.ru)
repositories.about: History, photographs and coordinates of churches.
repositories.how: Use it to find the parish of a village and the years the church existed.

repositories.name: Officers of the Russian Imperial Army
repositories.about: Biographical reference on officers of the Russian army before 1917 compiled from orders and lists.
repositories.how: Good for officers; for soldiers use gwar.mil.ru.

repositories.name: Regional state archives (Russia)
repositories.about: The main holdings: parish registers, confession and revision lists, zemstvo household cards, Soviet household books of village councils.
repositories.how: Many regional archives now publish scans or catalogues online; otherwise send a written request with the church, years and names (see draft_archive_request).

repositories.name: Civil registry offices (ZAGS)
repositories.about: Birth, marriage and death records since 1918 (older ones are mostly in state archives).
repositories.how: Archival copies are issued to relatives who prove the relationship; records under 100 years old are restricted.

repositories.name: Central Archive of the Ministry of Defence (TsAMO)
repositories.about: Personnel files and records of the Soviet army after 1941; much is online via Pamyat Naroda.
repositories.how: Check Pamyat Naroda first; request what is not there with full name, birth year and unit.

repositories.name: Russian State Military History Archive (RGVIA)
repositories.about: Service records of officers and military officials before 1918, regimental records.
repositories.how: Service records survive mainly for officers; for soldiers look at regimental lists and gwar.mil.ru.

repositories.name: Russian State Historical Archive (RGIA)
repositories.about: Records of ministries and the Synod: clergy, nobility, officials, institutions of the Empire.
repositories.how: Search the online catalogue of inventories before writing a request.

repositories.name: State Archive of the Russian Federation (GARF)
repositories.about: Records of the emigration, Soviet institutions and the police of the Russian Empire.
repositories.how: Useful for emigrants after 1917 and for political cases before 1917.

repositories.name: Tver regional archives portal (GATO) — paid image access
repositories.about: Catalogue of the Tver archives with paid daily access to scans: parish registers (f. 160, op. 15) and revision lists (f. 312, op. 6) of Tver province.
repositories.how: The list of digitised files (paid_access/gato_documents) shows only files with images. Access is paid per archive per day; frame numbers differ from folio numbers. If the viewer is blank or says 'no access' while the account shows paid time, it is a portal fault — record it as unavailable.

repositories.name: State Archive of Krasnoyarsk Krai — catalogue and remote access
repositories.about: Catalogue of the Krasnoyarsk archive (Yenisei province) with a remote-access system: scans through a personal account.
repositories.how: Metric books are in f. 60, registry books of churches 1871–1931 in f. R-2453. Long result lists may be cut at 100 rows — split by years or title words.

repositories.name: Krasnodar Krai State Archive (GAKK) — KAISA catalogue and remote viewing
repositories.about: Catalogue of the Krasnodar archive with name indexes to parish registers; scans are viewed remotely through kubanarchives.ru (paid by 3-hour periods).
repositories.how: Parish registers of the Kuban are f. 801 (by church and year); look the file up in the inventory first, then open it remotely or order a copy.

repositories.name: Kuban Genealogy — databases (A. Gorbonosov)
repositories.about: Free Excel databases compiled from GAKK files: residents of Kuban and the Black Sea province (400 000+ rows), settlers enrolled into the Kuban Cossack Host, residents of Yekaterinodar, Temryuk, Yeysk, Anapa, Maykop, Novorossiysk, conscripts, service records.
repositories.how: Rows give surname, name, place and year of the document only; the file reference is given by the compiler on request. Search the surname column only (the place column is also a stanitsa name, e.g. Gubskaya). A row is a lead to a file, not a fact.

repositories.name: State Archive of Kursk Region — EAIS
repositories.about: Kursk regional archive: published inventories of pre-revolutionary fonds (f. 184 revision lists, f. 217 parish registers) and an electronic system (kga.rkursk.ru) with remote access to some files.
repositories.how: Find the volost or village in the inventory titles first; files are arranged by district and estate, not by name.

repositories.name: State Archive of Belgorod Region (GABO)
repositories.about: Parish registers of the Belgorod area (parts of Kursk and Voronezh provinces), 1753–1925; inventories of church fonds as PDF.
repositories.how: Images are viewed only in the reading room (Elar system); remotely — by request with name, place and year.

repositories.name: State Archival Service of Ukraine
repositories.about: Portal of Ukrainian state archives; many regional archives publish scans of parish registers and revision lists.
repositories.how: Go to the site of the regional archive: scans are usually listed by fonds and inventory.

repositories.name: Central State Historical Archive of Ukraine in Kyiv (TsDIAK)
repositories.about: Parish registers of Kyiv and other provinces, records of imperial institutions in Ukraine.
repositories.how: Many registers are also filmed on FamilySearch; the archive site may not open from some countries.

repositories.name: Archives of Belarus
repositories.about: Portal of Belarusian state archives with guides and databases.
repositories.how: Parish registers of Belarus are also widely filmed on FamilySearch.

repositories.name: National Archives Agency of Moldova
repositories.about: Church books of Bessarabia, a database of the repressed and deported, guides to the fonds.
repositories.how: Names appear in Russian and Romanian forms (Василий / Vasile, Плешу / Pleșu): search both.

repositories.name: National Archives of Romania
repositories.about: Civil and church registers of Romania by county directorates.
repositories.how: Write to the county directorate; many registers are also on FamilySearch ('Romania, Church Books').

repositories.name: genealogica.ro
repositories.about: An index of parish and civil registers and censuses of the Old Kingdom of Romania.
repositories.how: The default search is fuzzy and by prefix: for one exact spelling set the search options to exact match (in the result URL numTypos=0&prefixSearch=false), narrow by county (judet) and by years (from/until, up to 1945). Searches are limited per hour — plan the name forms first (name_variants) and log what you ran.

repositories.name: Genealogy of Bessarabia (bessarabia.name)
repositories.about: A private project with indexed parish registers and revision lists, family trees and a separate document collection. Indexing covers selected books, not all of Bessarabia.
repositories.how: Start here to learn which uezd and parish a village belonged to and which fond holds its books; then read the books themselves (FamilySearch catalogue, National Archives of Moldova).

repositories.name: Deportations from Bessarabia (deportari.org)
repositories.about: Lists of people deported from Bessarabia and the Moldavian SSR in 1941–1951 (the waves of June 1941, July 1949 and April 1951), arranged by village.
repositories.how: Browse the list of the village, not only the name: whole families were deported together, and names are in Russian and Romanian forms (name_variants). The personal file is in the National Archives of Moldova or the archive of the Information and Security Service.

repositories.name: Cartea Memoriei (Moldova): catalogue of the victims of communist totalitarianism
repositories.about: A printed catalogue in four volumes (Chișinău, 1999–2005, coordinated by Elena Postică) of people from Moldova deported, arrested or killed by the Soviet regime, grouped by place.
repositories.how: Look up the village: an entry gives the year, the kind of repression and often the place of exile. Libraries in Moldova and Romania hold it; JewishGen has an index of the Jewish victims from it.

repositories.name: Moldavian censuses of 1772–1774 (Dmitriev, «Молдавия в эпоху феодализма», vol. VII)
repositories.about: P. G. Dmitriev (comp.), «Молдавия в эпоху феодализма», vol. VII, in two parts (Kishinev: Shtiintsa, 1975): the Russian-administered censuses of the Principality of Moldavia of 1772–1773 and 1774, household by household with the heads of households by name, from the originals in RGADA (fond 293).
repositories.how: The earliest name list for most Moldavian and Bessarabian villages, but with gaps: the 1774 census of Codru ținut has not survived, and for Fălciu only the number of households is given. Villages appear under the ținut of the time; the head of household is often named by a given name and a nickname or father's name rather than a fixed surname.

repositories.name: Geneteka
repositories.about: A volunteer index of millions of Polish parish and civil records, including former western provinces of the Russian Empire.
repositories.how: Search by surname across a province; the index links to scans on Metryki or Szukajwarchiwach where they exist.

repositories.name: Szukajwarchiwach (Polish State Archives)
repositories.about: Millions of scans from Polish state archives: parish and civil registers, population books.
repositories.how: Search by town and record type, then browse the scans.

repositories.name: Epaveldas (Lithuania)
repositories.about: Digitised Lithuanian heritage including parish registers and revision lists.
repositories.how: Registers are in Latin, Polish and Russian: know the parish and the years.

repositories.name: Raduraksti (Latvia)
repositories.about: Latvian church books, revision lists and censuses as scans.
repositories.how: Lutheran books are in German; Orthodox in Russian.

repositories.name: National Archives of Estonia
repositories.about: Digitised church books, revision lists and other records of Estonia.
repositories.how: Use the archive's information system to browse by parish.

repositories.name: State Archive of Poltava Region (DAPO) — e-resource and FamilySearch tables
repositories.about: Catalogue of the Poltava archive; its parish registers (f. 1011) are filmed by FamilySearch, and the archive publishes Excel tables matching film numbers (DGS) to fond-opis-file.
repositories.how: Find the parish in the archive's 2019 catalogue of metric books, take its file number, map it to a DGS through the tables and read the film; later inventories (f. 1011, op. 6–17) are not in the catalogue — read file covers. Civil registers: f. R-9126, partly on Wikisource/Commons.

repositories.name: State Archive of Sumy Region (DASO) — e-archive of metric books
repositories.about: Metric books and confession lists of Sumy region, including parishes of the former Poltava province (Romny spiritual board, f. 960).
repositories.how: Section 'Документи on-line' → 'Е-архів' → 'Метричні книги'. May answer HTTP 403 from abroad or to scripts — then unavailable, not empty.

repositories.name: Catholic parish registers of Ireland (NLI)
repositories.about: Microfilmed Catholic baptism and marriage registers, mostly up to 1880, by parish.
repositories.how: Browse by parish; for name indexes use irishgenealogy.ie and FamilySearch.

repositories.name: IrishGenealogy.ie
repositories.about: Irish civil records of births, marriages and deaths with images, and some church registers.
repositories.how: Civil registration starts in 1864 (non-Catholic marriages in 1845).

repositories.name: Census of Ireland 1901 and 1911
repositories.about: Every household of Ireland in 1901 and 1911, searchable by name and townland.
repositories.how: Search by townland, not only by name: the whole household shows who lived together.

repositories.name: FreeBMD
repositories.about: Index of civil registration births, marriages and deaths in England and Wales.
repositories.how: Gives the quarter, district, volume and page to order the certificate from the GRO.

repositories.name: US National Archives (NARA)
repositories.about: Federal censuses, military service and pension files, naturalisation and immigration records.
repositories.how: Census images are free on FamilySearch; NARA guides say which series hold what.

repositories.name: Statue of Liberty – Ellis Island passenger search
repositories.about: Ship manifests of passengers arriving in New York.
repositories.how: Names were written as heard: search by first name, age and town of origin with wildcards.

repositories.name: Chronicling America
repositories.about: Historic American newspapers with full-text search (Library of Congress).
repositories.how: Obituaries and local news name relatives and places of origin.

repositories.name: Volksbund grave search
repositories.about: German war graves of both world wars, including Soviet and other foreign dead buried in Germany.
repositories.how: Search by surname and date of birth; check spelling variants.

repositories.name: ICRC prisoners of the First World War
repositories.about: Index cards and lists of about two million prisoners of war of 1914–1918 kept by the Red Cross.
repositories.how: Search by surname; the cards point to lists with the camp, unit and home place.

repositories.name: Commonwealth War Graves Commission
repositories.about: The dead of the British Commonwealth forces in both world wars and their graves or memorials.
repositories.how: Records often name parents or a widow and their address.

repositories.name: ScotlandsPeople
repositories.about: Scottish parish registers, civil registration from 1855 and censuses, with images.
repositories.how: Searching is free; viewing images costs credits. Scottish certificates name both parents, including the mother's maiden name.

repositories.name: Archion (Protestant church books, Germany)
repositories.about: Scans of Protestant parish registers from German regional churches, including former eastern provinces.
repositories.how: No name index: find the parish first (GenWiki, old gazetteers). A pass is bought by the month.

repositories.name: GenWiki and CompGen (Germany)
repositories.about: German genealogy wiki: places with their parishes and registry offices, address books, family-history databases.
repositories.how: Look up the place to learn which parish and Standesamt it belonged to, and where its books are now.

repositories.name: FranceArchives and departmental archives
repositories.about: Portal to French archives; each departmental archive publishes parish and civil registers online for free.
repositories.how: Find the commune, then its departmental archive site; ten-year tables (tables décennales) speed up the search.

repositories.name: Mémoire des hommes
repositories.about: French military records: soldiers who died in the First World War, service and war records.
repositories.how: The death card gives the date and place of birth — the way back to the birth register.

repositories.name: Antenati (Italy)
repositories.about: Scans of Italian civil registers from the state archives, with a growing name index.
repositories.how: Browse by state archive, town and year; registers have annual indexes at the end.

repositories.name: PARES (Spanish archives)
repositories.about: Spanish state archives, including the Archive of the Indies and records of emigration to the Americas.
repositories.how: Search the catalogue by name; passenger and emigration records help trace families to Latin America.

repositories.name: Digitarq (Portuguese archives)
repositories.about: Portuguese national and district archives: parish registers, passports and emigration records.
repositories.how: Passport registers of the district archives are the key to Portuguese emigrants to Brazil.

repositories.name: Open Archives (Netherlands, Belgium)
repositories.about: Hundreds of millions of indexed Dutch and Belgian records from many archives in one search.
repositories.how: Dutch civil records name the parents of bride and groom: build the family generation by generation.

repositories.name: State Archives of Belgium — search
repositories.about: Parish and civil registers of Belgium, indexed and as scans.
repositories.how: Search persons by name; open the scan from the result.

repositories.name: Swedish National Archives (Riksarkivet)
repositories.about: Swedish church books and household examination rolls (husförhörslängder), censuses and more, free online.
repositories.how: Household examination rolls follow a family year by year and give the parish of birth of each member.

repositories.name: Digitalarkivet (Norway)
repositories.about: Norwegian church books, censuses and emigration lists, with transcriptions.
repositories.how: Farm names change with moves: follow the farm as well as the surname.

repositories.name: Danish Family Search
repositories.about: Danish censuses and church books indexed by volunteers, linked to the scans of the Danish National Archives.
repositories.how: Censuses every few years show the household; church books confirm births and marriages.

repositories.name: HisKi (Finland)
repositories.about: Transcribed Finnish parish registers of baptisms, marriages and burials.
repositories.how: Search by parish and name; the originals are in the National Archives' digital archive.

repositories.name: Hungaricana
repositories.about: Hungarian cultural heritage portal: archival records, directories, newspapers and maps with full-text search.
repositories.how: Search names in Hungarian spelling, also for places that are now in Slovakia, Romania, Serbia or Croatia.

repositories.name: FamilySearch — Latin American collections
repositories.about: The largest online body of Latin American parish and civil registers: Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Peru and the rest.
repositories.how: Search the catalogue by country → state or province → municipality; Catholic baptisms usually name grandparents and godparents.

repositories.name: General Archive of the Nation (Mexico)
repositories.about: National archive of Mexico: colonial and national records, immigration registers of foreigners.
repositories.how: Immigration registration cards of foreigners (1926–1951) carry photographs and places of origin.

repositories.name: National Archives of Brazil (SIAN)
repositories.about: Brazilian national archive: immigration and naturalisation records, passenger lists of the port of Rio de Janeiro.
repositories.how: Search the SIAN catalogue by name; for São Paulo look at the Museu da Imigração.

repositories.name: Museu da Imigração (São Paulo)
repositories.about: Records of the immigrants' hostel of São Paulo: arrivals, families, places of origin and destinations.
repositories.how: Families arrived together: the entry gives every member and the plantation they were sent to.

repositories.name: Hemeroteca Digital Brasileira
repositories.about: Brazilian historical newspapers of the National Library with full-text search.
repositories.how: Ship arrivals, notices and obituaries were printed in the papers; search by name and decade.

repositories.name: CEMLA — arrivals in Argentina
repositories.about: Passenger arrivals in Buenos Aires compiled by the Centre for Latin American Migration Studies.
repositories.how: Spellings vary a lot: try Italian, Spanish, Russian and German forms of the name; a search certificate is paid.

repositories.name: General Archive of the Nation (Argentina)
repositories.about: National archive of Argentina: colonial and national censuses, immigration and administrative records.
repositories.how: National censuses of 1869 and 1895 are also on FamilySearch.

repositories.name: National Archive of Chile
repositories.about: National archive of Chile: notarial, judicial and administrative records, civil registry copies.
repositories.how: Notarial records (wills, sales of land) often name several generations.

repositories.name: Casualty lists of WWI (Verlustlisten 1. Weltkrieg)
repositories.about: Indexed Prussian, Bavarian, Saxon and Württemberg casualty lists of the First World War, about 8.5 million entries.
repositories.how: Search by surname and place of birth: entries give origin and fate (killed, wounded, captured). Unit details were omitted from late 1916 until late 1918, so not every entry identifies a regiment.

repositories.name: GEDBAS (genealogy.net)
repositories.about: Family trees uploaded by German genealogists, searchable by name and place.
repositories.how: Other people's trees: take them as leads and check every fact in the parish books.

repositories.name: Online local family books (Online-OFB)
repositories.about: Ortsfamilienbücher: all families of a parish reconstructed from its registers, place by place.
repositories.how: If your village has an OFB, it often goes back to the 1600s; cite the parish register it names, not the book.

repositories.name: German Digital Library (Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek)
repositories.about: One search over German libraries, archives and museums: address books, newspapers, archive finding aids.
repositories.how: Use the newspaper portal (Deutsches Zeitungsportal) for notices, and finding aids to locate files in state archives.

repositories.name: Federal Archives of Germany (Bundesarchiv)
repositories.about: German federal records: Wehrmacht personnel (former WASt / Deutsche Dienststelle), GDR records, the 1939 minority census.
repositories.how: Wehrmacht soldiers and Soviet POWs registered by Germany: request from the department Deutsches Reich in Berlin-Tegel (responsible since September 2025; former PA/WASt holdings).

repositories.name: Baltic Biographical Lexicon (BBLD)
repositories.about: Biographies of Baltic Germans: nobility, clergy, scholars, officials of Estland, Livland and Courland.
repositories.how: Each entry cites its sources — follow them to church books and university registers.

repositories.name: Odessa3 — Black Sea Germans
repositories.about: Transcribed records of German colonists in the Black Sea region and Bessarabia: church books, censuses, emigration lists.
repositories.how: Browse by colony; many transcriptions come from the St Petersburg Lutheran consistory duplicates.

repositories.name: JRI-Poland (Jewish Records Indexing)
repositories.about: Index of Jewish births, marriages and deaths from Polish archives — over 6 million records.
repositories.how: Search uses Beider–Morse phonetic matching; sign in to a free researcher account to see full results; the index gives the archive, year and act number to order the scan.

repositories.name: Gesher Galicia
repositories.about: Jewish and general records of Galicia: vital records indexes, cadastral maps, school and tax lists.
repositories.how: The All Galicia Database is free; some other content requires membership. Vital-record projects include 1940–1941. Cadastral maps show house numbers.

repositories.name: LitvakSIG
repositories.about: Lithuanian Jewish records: revision lists, family lists, box tax, vital records, internal passports.
repositories.how: Indexes appear on JewishGen; the newest translations are for donors first, then free.

repositories.name: Steve Morse One-Step tools
repositories.about: Search forms for Ellis Island, Castle Garden, US censuses (1790–1950) and other ports (Philadelphia manifests 1800–1963), plus calendar and alphabet converters. The forms are free; linked databases may require a paid subscription.
repositories.how: Use 'sounds like' (Daitch–Mokotoff) and search by town or ship when the name is mangled.

repositories.name: FreeCEN
repositories.about: Volunteer transcriptions of UK censuses 1841–1911 (coverage varies by county).
repositories.how: Check the coverage page first; fill gaps with FamilySearch indexes.

repositories.name: FreeREG
repositories.about: Volunteer transcriptions of English, Welsh and Scottish parish registers: baptisms, marriages, burials.
repositories.how: Before 1837 parish registers are the main source in England; check the original in the county record office.

repositories.name: The National Archives (UK) — Discovery
repositories.about: Catalogue of The National Archives and 2,500 other UK archives; many service records, wills and passenger lists online.
repositories.how: Search the catalogue by name: WWI medal cards, army and navy records and pre-1858 wills are downloadable.

repositories.name: General Register Office (England and Wales)
repositories.about: Indexes of births (with mother's maiden name) and deaths (with age) from 1837; certificates and cheap PDF copies.
repositories.how: Online indexes have gaps: births 1837–1934 and from 1984; deaths 1837–1957 and from 1984 (recent indexes end two years ago). Use FreeBMD or other indexes for gaps; certificate/PDF/image orders cost money.

repositories.name: Welsh Newspapers (National Library of Wales)
repositories.about: Over a million pages of Welsh newspapers with full-text search.
repositories.how: Search a name in quotes with the town; notices of deaths and marriages are short.

repositories.name: Library and Archives Canada
repositories.about: Canadian censuses 1825–1931, passenger lists 1865–1935, CEF soldiers of WWI (full files), naturalisations.
repositories.how: CEF personnel files are digitised in full; immigrants from the Russian Empire often appear as 'Galician', 'Austrian' or 'Russian'.

repositories.name: BAnQ — National Library and Archives of Quebec
repositories.about: Quebec parish registers (civil copies), notarial records, newspapers and judicial archives.
repositories.how: Quebec Catholic registers are among the most complete in the world; marriages name both sets of parents.

repositories.name: Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21
repositories.about: Help with ship arrivals to Halifax and other Canadian ports; research guides and family-history service.
repositories.how: Canadian arrival records for 1865–1935 are at LAC. The museum cannot access Canadian immigration records after 1935: request IRCC. Some later overseas departure lists are available. Research requests and record copies may incur fees.

repositories.name: Trove (National Library of Australia)
repositories.about: Millions of pages of Australian newspapers with full-text search, gazettes, books and directories.
repositories.how: Most digitised newspapers end in 1954; exceptions include The Canberra Times through 1995. Search in quotes by state and decade; correct OCR text to help others.

repositories.name: National Archives of Australia
repositories.about: WWI and WWII service records (WWI digitised in full), immigration and naturalisation files, alien registration. Identifiable census forms before 2001 were destroyed after statistical processing.
repositories.how: Many Russian-Empire migrants came via Harbin and Shanghai: search alien registration and naturalisation files.

repositories.name: Papers Past (New Zealand)
repositories.about: New Zealand newspapers, magazines and parliamentary papers with full-text search.
repositories.how: Shipping columns list arriving passengers; search the ship's name as well as the person's.

repositories.name: New Zealand BDM historical records
repositories.about: New Zealand historical indexes: births of living people at least 100 years ago; births of deceased people if born at least 80 years ago or dead at least 50; stillbirths at least 50; deaths at least 50 or born at least 80 years ago; marriages at least 75 years ago.
repositories.how: Order printouts cheaply: they name parents, which certificates of other countries often omit.

repositories.name: USGenWeb
repositories.about: Volunteer county pages for every US state: transcribed records, cemetery lists, courthouse addresses.
repositories.how: Find the county first: in the US most records (deeds, probate, marriages) are kept by the county.

repositories.name: Acta Publica (Moravia, Czechia)
repositories.about: Scanned parish and civil registers of the Moravian Land Archive in Brno and other Czech archives.
repositories.how: Czech registers are not indexed: find the parish (Farnost) of the village first, then browse by year; other regional archives run their own viewers.

repositories.name: National Archives of Finland — Astia
repositories.about: Astia provides access to digitised Finnish church books (communion books, births, marriages, deaths) and other records; it replaced the former Digital Archive.
repositories.how: Communion books (rippikirjat) follow families house by house like Russian confession lists; HisKi gives the index.

repositories.name: State Archives of Bulgaria
repositories.about: Bulgarian state archives: parish registers, civil registration, Ottoman-era documents, refugee files.
repositories.how: Orthodox registers use the Julian calendar until 1916; many Bessarabian Bulgarians are found in Moldovan and Odesa archives.

repositories.name: Metryki (genealodzy.pl) — scans
repositories.about: Scans of parish and civil-religious registers from Polish and some Ukrainian and Lithuanian archives, linked from Geneteka.
repositories.how: Open the scan straight from a Geneteka hit; the act number leads to the page.

repositories.name: Poznań Project — marriages 1800–1899
repositories.about: Index of nearly all marriages in the Grand Duchy of Posen in the 19th century, Catholic, Protestant and Jewish.
repositories.how: A marriage entry gives ages and the parish — the way back to both births.

repositories.name: National Archives of Georgia
repositories.about: Parish registers of Orthodox, Armenian, Catholic and Lutheran churches of Georgia, Tiflis governorate records.
repositories.how: Request by church and year; German colonies of the Caucasus are in the Lutheran registers.

repositories.name: Central State Archive of Kazakhstan
repositories.about: Central State Archive in Almaty: records of imperial and Soviet Kazakhstan, including documents from the early 18th century.
repositories.how: Identify the province, parish and years in the fond guide; also check regional archives. For deportation and special-settlement files, ask which archive or Interior Ministry office holds the file.

repositories.name: National Archive of Uzbekistan / Uzarchive
repositories.about: Uzarchive agency and the National Archive of Uzbekistan (formerly the Central State Archive): a route to Turkestan and Soviet archival fonds.
repositories.how: Use the agency's archive directory and services to identify the custodian, fond and years before requesting a file; not all records are at the national archive.

repositories.name: Central State Archive of the Kyrgyz Republic
repositories.about: Central State Archive in Bishkek; its published fond guide covers 1850–2015, including imperial and Soviet records.
repositories.how: Start with the official Central State Archive fond guide; search the historical district and institution as well as the modern village name, and check regional archives.

repositories.name: Main Archival Administration of Tajikistan
repositories.about: Official archival administration of Tajikistan: a route to central and regional state archives.
repositories.how: Ask the administration which archive holds records for the place, institution and years. Confirm availability and access before requesting parish, civil or special-settlement files.

repositories.name: Main Archival Administration of Turkmenistan
repositories.about: Official directory of the Central State Archive and regional archives of Turkmenistan. Civil-registration records are not deposited with this administration or its subordinate archives.
repositories.how: Identify the custodian through the official archive directory; ask about historical holdings and access. Request civil-registration records from the civil registry, not these archives.

repositories.name: State Archive of Tula Region (ГАТО)
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: State Archive of Ivanovo Region (ГАИО)
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: State Archive of Kostroma Region (ГАКО)
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: State Archive of Voronezh Region (ГАВО)
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: Archive of Contemporary History of Kostroma Region (ГАНИКО)
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: Chekhov municipal archive (official municipal portal)
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: National Historical Archives of Belarus in Grodno: inventories
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: State Archives of Kyiv City: fonds
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: State Archives of Khmelnytskyi Region
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.
repositories.note: 2026-10-21: the former PDF URL /pdf/mbv8-b1.pdf returned a hosting suspension page. Recheck the official archive directory; this is not a completed record search.

repositories.name: State Archive of Volgograd Region: fonds
repositories.about: Direct archive or municipal portal: find the relevant fond and inventory; dates and online image access depend on the collection.
repositories.how: Search by historical parish, district or institution, then fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not prove that images are online. Check access before a visit; do not send a request unless project policy and the owner allow it.

repositories.name: Petrovy: family and local history materials
repositories.about: A private family-history site with local-history material. Use relevant transcriptions as pointers to original records, not as a complete district index.
repositories.how: Browse the materials by village and topic; check the original archive reference and image before attaching a person.

repositories.name: Soldat.ru: military reference works
repositories.about: Military reference works, documents and search guidance; not a complete personal service-record database.
repositories.how: Use the reference and documents sections to interpret units and abbreviations, then corroborate with the original military record.

repositories.name: Pomnim.online: burial database
repositories.about: Burial and cemetery search with separate paid services. Coverage depends on contributions and cemetery data.
repositories.how: Search the surname and cemetery; verify the photograph, dates and identity. Do not order paid services automatically.

repositories.name: Heroes of the Country (Герои страны)
repositories.about: Biographies and bibliographic references about decorated people; a secondary source, not proof of kinship.
repositories.how: Search by name and use cited books and award records to locate originals; distinguish namesakes.

repositories.name: Ivanovo regional digital library
repositories.about: The regional digital library: local publications and reference books; access depends on the item.
repositories.how: Search the publication title, place and historical spelling; cite the edition and page, not just a search hit.

repositories.name: Vernadsky National Library of Ukraine: library portal
repositories.about: Vernadsky Library / NAS library portal and catalogues. A bibliographic entry does not guarantee an online full text.
repositories.how: Search author, title and place; follow the item link to establish image/text availability and cite the original page.

repositories.name: State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of Russia
repositories.about: Museum object catalogue: photographs, manuscripts, documents and other collection objects, not a comprehensive population register.
repositories.how: Search the name, place and object description; record the museum and inventory number. Check rights separately before reuse.

repositories.name: Kostroma regional library: electronic local collection
repositories.about: The library's electronic local collection of Kostroma publications and book monuments.
repositories.how: Choose the period and title, then read the scan; OCR or a catalogue title alone does not establish a person's identity.

repositories.name: Familio: knowledge base and settlement reference works
repositories.about: Settlement reference works and family trees; basic reference access and optional paid features are separate.
repositories.how: Use historical place entries to find parish and administrative names. User trees are leads: follow their documents.

repositories.name: Genway: user-contributed trees
repositories.about: User-contributed genealogy service. Visibility and availability must be checked; a surname or tree owner is only a lead.
repositories.how: Check whether the service opens and what is visible without an account. Do not infer kinship from a surname match or investigate living people's current lives.

repositories.name: Bessarabia.ru: historical reference materials
repositories.about: Historical Bessarabian reference materials and archive guides; a different website from bessarabia.name.
repositories.how: Check availability and each publication's scope and date. Use institutional and settlement references to locate originals, not as a complete parish index.

repositories.name: FamilySearch Family Tree
repositories.about: The collaborative family tree, distinct from the historical-record index and image catalogue.
repositories.how: Search the tree for leads; inspect attached sources and independently verify every relationship in the original record.

repositories.name: HathiTrust Digital Library
repositories.about: Digitised research-library books and full-text discovery; reading and download rights vary by item.
repositories.how: Search historical spellings and titles; distinguish a catalogue/full-text hit from an accessible page.

repositories.name: Google Books
repositories.about: Book discovery with full views, previews or snippets depending on rights.
repositories.how: Verify the edition and page in the scan. A snippet or API quota error is not a completed search of the book.

repositories.name: Gallica — Bibliothèque nationale de France
repositories.about: BnF digital library of books, periodicals and other heritage collections.
repositories.how: Search name variants and dates; compare OCR with the page image and cite its persistent identifier.

repositories.name: Limédia — Lorraine digital collections and Kiosque
repositories.about: Lorraine heritage collections; Kiosque provides free access to historical newspapers.
repositories.how: Choose Kiosque for press, then title and date; access rules differ between Limédia services.

repositories.name: RetroNews — BnF historical press
repositories.about: Historical French press. BnF describes free archive consultation and subscription-based advanced features and editorial content.
repositories.how: Check title and issue dates; distinguish free archive pages from subscription-only search and editorial features.

repositories.name: matchID — INSEE deceased-person files
repositories.about: Search of INSEE deceased-person files from 1970, including registered deaths in France and abroad.
repositories.how: Compare birth details and spelling variants. No match does not prove that a person did not die in France.

repositories.name: Iverieli — National Parliamentary Library of Georgia
repositories.about: Digital collections of the National Parliamentary Library of Georgia.
repositories.how: Search titles and historical spellings; some collections are restricted to the library network. Inspect the page image.

repositories.name: Polona — National Library of Poland
repositories.about: Digital books, periodicals and other collections of the National Library of Poland and partners.
repositories.how: Check OCR against the scan, record the edition and page; item access may depend on rights.

repositories.name: Archives of Saint Petersburg
repositories.about: Official portal of Saint Petersburg archives, fonds and archival reference services.
repositories.how: Identify the archive, fond, inventory and file. A catalogue entry does not guarantee free online images.

repositories.name: Archives of the Don — Rostov region
repositories.about: Official Rostov-region archival portal with fonds, register references and a virtual reading room.
repositories.how: Check the holding archive and inventory before opening scans; do not assume all Don records are digitised.

repositories.name: Don State Public Library — digital library
repositories.about: Digital local-history books and periodicals of the Don State Public Library.
repositories.how: Use the catalogue and its Vivaldi viewer; a book without searchable OCR still needs page-by-page inspection.

repositories.name: PubMed — biomedical bibliography
repositories.about: Biomedical bibliographic search, useful for historical physicians and authors; full texts are not always included.
repositories.how: Disambiguate authors by dates, institution and coauthors. A namesake publication does not establish kinship.

repositories.name: CyberLeninka — open scholarly articles
repositories.about: Open-access scholarly articles, including local history and historical research.
repositories.how: Use references to find originals; separate the author’s interpretation from a transcribed archival record.

repositories.name: Russian State Library — search catalogue
repositories.about: RSL bibliographic catalogue; an entry may link to a digital copy with its own access conditions.
repositories.how: Search title, author and historical place; distinguish the shelfmark, catalogue description and full-text availability.

repositories.name: Wayback Machine — archived web pages
repositories.about: Historical snapshots of websites, distinct from Internet Archive book full-text search.
repositories.how: Use the original URL and snapshot date. An archived page documents what was published then, not current availability.

repositories.name: UkrFamily — public archive references
repositories.about: Public archive inventories and genealogy reference pages alongside private research services.
repositories.how: Verify archive, fond, opis and file against the official archive; viewing a public index does not authorise ordering services.

repositories.name: Ukrainian Wikisource
repositories.about: Volunteer transcriptions and digitised historical publications, sometimes linked to page scans.
repositories.how: Verify transcription against the scan and cite the original publication, volume and page.

repositories.name: DigiBuc — Bucharest Metropolitan Library
repositories.about: Bucharest Metropolitan Library digital collections; the portal redirects to its DigiTool service.
repositories.how: Check the title and issue, try Romanian diacritics and OCR variants. A timeout on the legacy portal is not a negative record search.

repositories.name: Lucian Blaga Central University Library Cluj — digital library
repositories.about: Digital books and periodicals of the Cluj university library.
repositories.how: Search titles and name variants; verify that the requested newspaper and year actually belong to this collection.

repositories.name: Moldavica — National Library of Moldova
repositories.about: National Library of Moldova digital heritage collections.
repositories.how: Inspect scanned issues if OCR is absent; label any locally generated OCR as a derivative, not the original text.

repositories.name: Arcanum Digitheca
repositories.about: Digitised periodicals and books; access depends on the collection and subscription.
repositories.how: Check the publication and access conditions. A blocked request or paywall is not evidence that a name is absent.

repositories.name: Moldova ASP — civil-status services
repositories.about: Official civil-status service information of Moldova’s Public Services Agency; not a public person-search database.
repositories.how: Check eligibility and required documents. Record an owner task for restricted certificates; do not submit an application automatically.

repositories.name: Patronim — genealogy website directory
repositories.about: Directory of genealogy and local-history websites, not an indexed person database.
repositories.how: Use it to discover resources; verify each destination and do not treat directory search as a surname search in records.

repositories.name: Famiry — user family trees
repositories.about: Family-tree service with account-dependent access; public surname articles are not individual records.
repositories.how: Inspect attached documents after authorised login; a blocked tree is an incomplete check, not a no-hit result.

repositories.name: FamilySpace — genealogy community and trees
repositories.about: User-contributed genealogy service; availability and visibility require checking.
repositories.how: Use public material only as leads; account requirements or an unavailable site must be logged separately from no matches.

repositories.name: Freedmen's Bureau Records
repositories.about: 3.5 million records (1865 to 1872) including labor contracts, marriage records, hospital records, school records, ration lists, and complaints. The single most important post-emancipation source.

repositories.name: Freedman's Bank Records
repositories.about: Applications for bank accounts (1865 to 1874) that include birthplace, age, complexion, occupation, spouse, children, siblings, parents, and sometimes the former slaveholder's name. Extraordinarily detailed.

repositories.name: US Federal Census Slave Schedules (1850, 1860)
repositories.about: List enslaved people by slaveholder name, county, age, sex, and color. Names are rarely included; people are identified only by demographic information.

repositories.name: Ancestry.com
repositories.about: Largest commercial collection of African American records including Freedmen's Bureau, slave narratives (WPA Federal Writers' Project), Freedman's Bank, and USCT military records. Some African American and slavery collections are permanently free.

repositories.name: FamilySearch
repositories.about: Extensive free collections including Freedmen's Bureau, Freedman's Bank, census records, and state-level records

repositories.name: Enslaved.org
repositories.about: Aggregated database of records of enslaved people drawn from multiple institutions and research projects. Links records across collections.

repositories.name: Last Seen: Finding Family After Slavery
repositories.about: Database of "information wanted" advertisements placed by formerly enslaved people in newspapers after the Civil War. These ads sought lost family members separated by sale or war and contain names, relationships, locations, and slaveholder names.

repositories.name: Afro-American Historical and Genealogical Society (AAHGS)
repositories.about: Publications, research guides, and regional chapters focused on African American genealogy

repositories.name: National Museum of African American History and Culture (NMAAHC)
repositories.about: Robert Frederick Smith Family History Center in Washington, DC. Free, in-person genealogy assistance with professional genealogists and access to subscription databases.

repositories.name: Ancestry.com.au
repositories.about: Australian collections including convict records, immigration and passenger lists, vital records indexes, electoral rolls, military records, and newspapers.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Australia collections)
repositories.about: Indexed and image collections including church records, civil registration, and immigration records.

repositories.name: LINC Tasmania
repositories.about: Tasmania's archives including convict records, pioneer records, names indexes, and historical photographs. Tasmania received convicts from 1803 to 1853 and has particularly rich convict documentation.

repositories.name: Convict Records
repositories.about: Database of over 160,000 convicts transported to Australia from 1788 to 1868. Searchable by name, ship, and year.

repositories.name: BDM Online
repositories.about: Births (1848 onward), marriages (1854 onward), deaths (1848 onward). Free index search; certificates available for purchase.

repositories.name: Archives New Zealand
repositories.about: Government records including immigration and passenger lists, military service records, naturalization files, and land records.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (New Zealand collections)
repositories.about: Church records, civil registration indexes, and other collections.

repositories.name: ANNO (Austrian Newspapers Online)
repositories.about: Historical Austrian newspapers, fully digitized and OCR-searchable

repositories.name: Lehmann Vienna Directories
repositories.about: Vienna address directories, 1859 to 1942

repositories.name: GenTeam
repositories.about: Indexed Austrian records including Vienna Jewish records, military records, citizenship records

repositories.name: Friedhöfe Wien (Vienna Cemeteries)
repositories.about: Vienna municipal cemetery burial database

repositories.name: IKG Wien (Jewish Community Vienna)
repositories.about: Vienna Jewish vital records (births, marriages, deaths) 1784 to 1938

repositories.name: Austrian State Archives (Österreichisches Staatsarchiv)
repositories.about: Military records (Kriegsarchiv), civil records, nobility records

repositories.name: Ancestry.ca
repositories.about: Canadian census records, vital records, immigration and passenger lists, military records, and newspapers.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Canada collections)
repositories.about: Indexed and image collections from all provinces. Includes church records, civil registration indexes, and land records.

repositories.name: Canadiana
repositories.about: Digitized historical publications, city and county directories, and some vital records.

repositories.name: AutomatedGenealogy.com
repositories.about: Indexed 1901, 1906, and 1911 Canadian federal censuses. Volunteer-transcribed.

repositories.name: Quebec PRDH (Programme de recherche en demographie historique)
repositories.about: Complete reconstruction of Quebec's population from 1621 to 1799, built from Catholic parish registers. The most complete historical demographic database of any population in the world. Includes baptisms, marriages, burials, and family reconstitutions.

repositories.name: BMS2000
repositories.about: Quebec vital events from Catholic parish registers: baptisms (B), marriages (M), and burials (S, for "sepulture"). Extends coverage beyond the PRDH into the 1800s and 1900s.

repositories.name: The National Archives (TNA)
repositories.about: Wills (1384 to 1858), military records, immigration records, Nonconformist registers, and much more. TNA Discovery catalog indexes millions of records.

repositories.name: FindMyPast
repositories.about: Strongest subscription service for English and Welsh records. Parish registers, census images, newspapers (British Newspaper Archive), military, workhouse records.

repositories.name: Ancestry.co.uk
repositories.about: Census records (1841 to 1921), BMD indexes, military records, immigration, passenger lists, parish records

repositories.name: FamilySearch (England and Wales collections)
repositories.about: Large indexed collections including parish registers, civil registration indexes, census records

repositories.name: Archives departementales
repositories.about: Each of France's 101 departements has its own website with digitized records. Most have civil registration (from 1792) and parish registers (from the 1500s) available for free browsing.
repositories.how: The main challenge is that each of the 101 departement sites has its own design, navigation, and URL structure. There is no unified national portal for these records.

repositories.name: Filae
repositories.about: Indexed French civil registration, census records, military records. Strong OCR-based search across digitized records.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (France collections)
repositories.about: Significant French holdings including indexed and browse-only image collections. Civil registration, parish registers, notarial records.

repositories.name: Archives nationales
repositories.about: National-level records including notarial archives, emigration records, nobility documentation, and records of national significance.

repositories.name: Base Leonore
repositories.about: Database of Legion of Honor recipients. Dossiers include biographical details, service records, and sometimes photographs.

repositories.name: Matricula Online
repositories.about: Catholic parish records (Germany, Austria, Poland, and others)

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Germany collections)
repositories.about: Indexed vital records, church records, and civil registration for many German states

repositories.name: Ancestry.com (Germany collections)
repositories.about: Various German collections including emigration records, some indexed church records

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Hungary collections)
repositories.about: Large collection of indexed and image-based records. Church records (Catholic, Reformed, Lutheran, Jewish, Greek Catholic), civil registration (post-1895), and census-like records.

repositories.name: Matricula Online
repositories.about: Catholic parish records from some Hungarian dioceses. Baptisms, marriages, deaths. Browse by diocese and parish.

repositories.name: Arcanum
repositories.about: The largest Hungarian digital content provider. Digitized newspapers, historical documents, some genealogical records. Includes county histories, biographical dictionaries, and periodicals.

repositories.name: Magyar Nemzeti Levéltár (Hungarian National Archives)
repositories.about: Civil registration records (post-1895), county records, noble family records, censuses, conscriptions. Physical archives in Budapest and county seats (megyei levéltárak).

repositories.name: Radix
repositories.about: Indexed Hungarian vital records (baptisms, marriages, deaths) from selected parishes and civil registration offices.

repositories.name: Griffith's Valuation
repositories.about: 1847 to 1864 property valuation covering all of Ireland. Lists every head of household, the townland, landlord, and property description.
repositories.how: The single most important census substitute for Irish research.

repositories.name: Tithe Applotment Books (1820s to 1830s)
repositories.about: Pre-famine record of land occupiers liable for tithes. Covers most of rural Ireland.

repositories.name: HistoricGraves.com
repositories.about: Community-sourced graveyard inscription database across Ireland

repositories.name: FindMyPast
repositories.about: Largest subscription collection of Irish records. Includes 1901 and 1911 censuses, Griffith's Valuation, Tithe Applotment Books, Catholic parish registers, landed estates court records, newspapers.

repositories.name: Ancestry.com
repositories.about: Irish collections including Landed Estates Court records, some indexed civil and church records

repositories.name: PRONI (Public Record Office of Northern Ireland)
repositories.about: Records for the six counties of Northern Ireland (Antrim, Armagh, Derry, Down, Fermanagh, Tyrone). Church records, estate papers, valuation records.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Ireland collections)
repositories.about: Indexed civil registration, some church records, Tithe Applotment Books

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Italy collections)
repositories.about: The largest free collection of Italian genealogy records. Some collections indexed (searchable by name), many browse-only image sets.

repositories.name: Ancestry.com (Italy collections)
repositories.about: Some indexed Italian collections including emigration records, passenger lists, and selected civil records

repositories.name: Cognome Distribution Maps
repositories.about: Shows where Italian surnames concentrate by province. Useful for identifying likely regions of origin when you do not know the specific comune.

repositories.name: Italian Genealogical Group
repositories.about: Volunteer organization with indexed New York area Italian records including naturalizations, vital records, and church records

repositories.name: JewishGen
repositories.about: The central hub for Jewish genealogy. Databases include the Family Tree of the Jewish People, Communities Database, Yizkor Book translations, vital records indexes, Holocaust databases, and ShtetlSeeker (locating towns by phonetic name matching).

repositories.name: Yad Vashem Central Database of Shoah Victims' Names
repositories.about: 4.8 million names of Holocaust victims. Based on Pages of Testimony submitted by survivors and family members, as well as historical documents.

repositories.name: ITS / Arolsen Archives
repositories.about: International Tracing Service archives containing 30 million documents: concentration camp records, displaced persons (DP) records, forced labor records, correspondence, and tracing requests. Recently opened for broad online access.

repositories.name: USHMM (United States Holocaust Memorial Museum)
repositories.about: Holocaust-related records, displaced persons records, ITS/Arolsen Archives access, survivor testimonies, photograph collections.

repositories.name: Avotaynu / Consolidated Jewish Surname Index (CJSI)
repositories.about: Publisher of Jewish genealogy resources. The CJSI is free and searches across 40+ databases simultaneously for surname matches.

repositories.name: JOWBR (JewishGen Online Worldwide Burial Registry)
repositories.about: Jewish cemetery inscriptions from around the world. Includes headstone transcriptions and photographs.

repositories.name: Gesher Galicia
repositories.about: Records from the former province of Galicia (now split between Poland and Ukraine). Cadastral maps, tax records, vital records, and town histories.

repositories.name: All Russia Family Tree (VGD)
repositories.about: Forum-based research community for Russian Empire records, including Jewish metric books and community records.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Jewish-relevant collections)
repositories.about: Digitized metric books from the Russian Empire, Austro-Hungarian Empire, and other regions. Growing indexed collections.

repositories.name: FamilySearch
repositories.about: The dominant platform for Latin American genealogy. Massive collections for Mexico, Brazil, Guatemala, Peru, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, and others. Includes Catholic parish records, civil registration, census records, and immigration records. Many indexed, many image-only.

repositories.name: Ancestry.com
repositories.about: Growing Latin American collections including Mexican civil registration, church records, and immigration. Some indexed collections.

repositories.name: AncestryDNA
repositories.about: DNA matching database with growing Latin American representation. Useful for connecting with relatives across the Americas.

repositories.name: Archivo General de Indias (Spain)
repositories.about: Colonial-era records for all of Spanish America. Passenger lists, emigration permits, colonial administration, correspondence, and land grants. Searchable through the PARES portal.

repositories.name: Registro Civil (varies by country)
repositories.about: Civil registration offices at the state, province, or municipal level. Access rules vary widely by country and jurisdiction.

repositories.name: WieWasWie
repositories.about: Central search portal for Dutch genealogy. Indexes civil registration, church records, and population registers from many archives across the Netherlands.

repositories.name: OpenArchives
repositories.about: Aggregated index of Dutch archival records. Over 100 million records from participating archives.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Netherlands collections)
repositories.about: Large indexed and image collections. Many Dutch records available including civil registration, church records, and population registers.

repositories.name: Alle Groningers
repositories.about: Complete genealogical database for the province of Groningen. Civil registration, church records, population registers.

repositories.name: Delpher
repositories.about: Royal Library's digitized newspapers, books, and periodicals. Millions of pages with full-text OCR search.

repositories.name: Ancestry.com
repositories.about: Some Dutch indexed collections including civil registration and emigration records.

repositories.name: Regionaal Archief (various)
repositories.about: Each region has its own archive website with digitized records. Examples include Stadsarchief Amsterdam, Regionaal Archief Tilburg, Het Utrechts Archief, and many others.

repositories.name: Digitalarkivet (Digital Archives of Norway)
repositories.about: Census records (1801, 1865, 1875, 1891, 1900, 1910), church records, emigration protocols, military rolls

repositories.name: National Library of Norway (nb.no)
repositories.about: Digitized books including bygdebøker (local history books), newspapers, maps

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Norway collections)
repositories.about: Indexed church records, census records, emigration records

repositories.name: Kvien Database
repositories.about: Western Norway farm lineages, particularly Nordfjord area
repositories.how: Volunteer-maintained. Excellent for specific farms in Sogn og Fjordane.

repositories.name: Mapa Nazwisk (Surname Map)
repositories.about: Modern distribution of Polish surnames

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Russia/Ukraine collections)
repositories.about: Rapidly growing collection. Metric books (metricheskie knigi) from many guberniyas are being digitized. Includes Orthodox, Catholic, Lutheran, and Jewish records.

repositories.name: Geni.com
repositories.about: Significant Russian and Ukrainian family trees, often with sourced data. Useful for finding connections and existing research.

repositories.name: Ukrainian State Archives (various)
repositories.about: The Central State Historical Archive of Ukraine in Kyiv (CDIAK) and Lviv (CDIAuL) hold the most extensive collections. Individual oblast archives hold records for their regions. Some have online catalogs; most require in-person or email research.

repositories.name: National Records of Scotland (NRS)
repositories.about: The government authority behind ScotlandsPeople. Physical archives in Edinburgh hold original records and collections not yet digitized.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Scotland collections)
repositories.about: Some indexed Scottish church and civil records, but significantly less comprehensive than ScotlandsPeople

repositories.name: FindMyPast
repositories.about: Scottish newspaper archives (British Newspaper Archive), some parish records

repositories.name: Ancestry
repositories.about: Some Scottish collections including census transcriptions and military records
repositories.how: For Scottish research, ScotlandsPeople is almost always the better primary source. Ancestry and FindMyPast are supplementary.

repositories.name: PARES (Portal de Archivos Españoles)
repositories.about: Spanish national archives portal. Documents from the Archivo General de Indias (colonial Americas), Archivo Historico Nacional, Archivo General de Simancas, and others. Millions of digitized documents.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Spain collections)
repositories.about: Large collection of Catholic parish records and civil registration from across Spain. Many indexed, many browse-only image sets.

repositories.name: Ancestry.com (Spain collections)
repositories.about: Some indexed Spanish collections including selected civil and church records

repositories.name: Catastro de Ensenada (1749 to 1756)
repositories.about: Detailed census of the Crown of Castile ordered by the Marquis of Ensenada. Lists head of household, occupation, property, family members, and livestock. One of the most comprehensive pre-modern censuses in Europe.

repositories.name: Regional Archives (Comunidades Autonomas)
repositories.about: Each Comunidad Autonoma has its own archive system with significant holdings. Catalonia (Arxiu Nacional de Catalunya), Basque Country (Irargi), Galicia (Arquivo de Galicia), and Andalusia (Archivo General de Andalucia) have the most extensive online collections.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Portugal collections)
repositories.about: Extensive collection of Portuguese parish records, civil registration, and passport records. Strong coverage for the Azores and Madeira.

repositories.name: Ancestry.com (Portugal collections)
repositories.about: Some Portuguese collections including selected civil and church records

repositories.name: Arkiv Digital
repositories.about: 110M+ images of Swedish church records, estate inventories, court records

repositories.name: SVAR (Svensk Arkivinformation)
repositories.about: Microfilmed Swedish church records

repositories.name: Emihamn (Swedish Emigration Database)
repositories.about: Port emigration records from 6 Swedish ports, 1869 to 1950 (1.4M names)
repositories.how: Only covers departures from 1869 onward. Earlier emigration may only appear in church "moving out" records.

repositories.name: Swedish Emigrant Institute (Emigrantinstitutet)
repositories.about: Emigrant letters, diaries, photographs, research library

repositories.name: FamilySearch
repositories.about: 1790 to 1950 (all available censuses)

repositories.name: Ancestry.com
repositories.about: 1790 to 1950, with the most comprehensive indexing

repositories.name: NARA (National Archives)
repositories.about: Original census records

repositories.name: FamilySearch
repositories.about: Indexed and digitized records from all 13 original colonies plus territories

repositories.name: Fold3
repositories.about: Military records including Revolutionary War pensions, muster rolls, bounty land warrants

repositories.name: Archive.org and Google Books
repositories.about: Published county histories, genealogies, and compiled records
repositories.how: In-copyright digitized genealogies that aren't fully readable can often be **borrowed** through the Open Library (https://openlibrary.org) with a free account.

repositories.name: DAR (Daughters of the American Revolution)
repositories.about: Patriot Index (Revolutionary War era service records), GRS database

repositories.name: Ellis Island / Statue of Liberty Foundation
repositories.about: New York arrivals, 1892 to 1957 (~65 million records)

repositories.name: Castle Garden (pre-Ellis NY arrivals, 1820–1892)
repositories.note: castlegarden.org has gone offline. The same New York arrivals (~11 million, 1820–1891) are now on **FamilySearch collection 1849782** ("New York Passenger Lists, 1820–1891"), the practical successor.

repositories.name: FamilySearch (Passenger Lists)
repositories.about: Multiple US and Canadian ports

repositories.name: Internet Archive — NARA Microfilm Page Images
repositories.about: The full New York arrival microfilm — M237 (1820–1897) and T715 (1897–1957) — as page images; the Internet Archive reel number matches the NARA roll number
repositories.how: Gives the actual manifest IMAGES, not just an index — essential when a name was never indexed and you must browse by ship and date. The film carries the same physical damage (torn or cut-off frames) as any other copy of that roll.
repositories.note: https://archive.org/ (National Archives passenger-microfilm reels, uploaded one item per reel)

repositories.name: NARA Bulk Passenger Data Files
repositories.about: Pipe-delimited text with origin-town, ship, arrival-date, and birthplace fields — searchable locally with ordinary text tools
repositories.how: Coverage is partial (weighted toward Russia and Austria-Hungary; sparse for Romania and post-1897), but useful for bulk searching when web indexes fail to surface a garbled name.
repositories.note: https://catalog.archives.gov/ (downloadable passenger datasets, e.g. the Castle Garden / Balch series)

repositories.name: USCIS Genealogy Program
repositories.about: Naturalization certificate files, 1906 to 1956

repositories.name: County and Federal Court Records
repositories.about: Naturalization petitions were filed in county, state, or federal courts

repositories.name: NARA Access to Archival Databases (AAD)
repositories.about: Selected electronic records transferred to NARA, including several large military files (WWII Army enlistments, Korean War and Vietnam War casualty/POW extracts, awards files)

repositories.name: FamilySearch — WWII Army Enlistment Records
repositories.about: Mirrors the AAD WWII Army enlistment data
repositories.how: Useful when AAD's interface is awkward; searchable while logged in.

repositories.name: NPS Soldiers and Sailors Database
repositories.about: Union and Confederate Civil War servicemen (compiled service-record index), regiments, sailors, cemeteries, Medal of Honor recipients

repositories.name: Fold3
repositories.about: Digitized military records across all major US conflicts (Revolution through modern), including many records not in AAD

repositories.name: National Personnel Records Center (NPRC) / SF-180
repositories.about: Official Military Personnel Files, medical records, pension files

repositories.name: State Vital Records Offices
repositories.about: Every state has a vital records office. Most have online ordering for certified copies.

repositories.name: FamilySearch
repositories.about: Many states have digitized older vital records (typically records older than 75 to 100 years)

repositories.name: Ancestry.com
repositories.about: Large collections of indexed vital records

repositories.name: County Clerks
repositories.about: For records predating state registration, the county clerk or recorder of deeds is often the best source.
